newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks down in morning on futures-linked trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks down in morning on futures-linked trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were easier on Thursday morning on index-related selling and Wall Street's fall overnight, but brokers said the Hang Seng Index was likely to recover in the afternoon after June index futures expire.
The Hang Seng Index was down 104 points, or 0.69 percent, to 14,960 on volume of HK$4.76 billion in the first 40 minutes.
"The bulls are staying on the sidelines while the bears try to sell down the index ahead of the expiry of index futures," said Michael Ng, dealing director of Sassoon Securities.
But red chips remained strong with the Hang Seng red chip index surging 42 points, or 1.33 percent, to 3,227.
